subject: Crossroads Health activation charter & owner demarcation
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodai.com>
To: Matthew Long <matthew@crossroadshealth.com>, Julia Tan <julia@crossroadshealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crossroads Health activation charter & owner demarcation

Hi Matthew / Julia —

Thanks again for signing — really excited to kick this off. Attached is a first-pass activation charter and a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the sprint-0 scope, acceptance criteria, and owner suggestions. Key things to call out up-front:

- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for the EHR summarization flow (internal-facing, HIPAA consented) with a goal to hit 95% reliability under the agreed latency SLO during pilot.
- Scope for sprint-0 (2 weeks): network & VPC connectivity validation, model selection + baseline perf run, and a first integration via our hosted API.
- Acceptance: successful tokenized generation at test rate (see MAP tab "acceptance") + infra sign-off from Crossroads infra.

Please confirm that the network contacts below are correct and that the proposed dates in the MAP work for you. I’ve CC’d Priya (implementation lead) and Lauren (CS manager) from our side — they’ll take over the detailed scheduling and runbook creation once we align on the sprint-0 window.

Attachments: CR_CSP_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, crossroads_network_requirements.pdf

Next steps:
1) Matthew/Julia: confirm network contact and availability for the week of Dec 7 for sprint-0 kick.
2) Priya: prep a short internal checklist (VPN keys, sample payloads, test corpus) and flag any pre-reqs we need from Crossroads infra.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your OK before we schedule the kickoff calendar invite.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for dev teams

Subject: Re: Crossroads Health activation charter & owner demarcation

Thanks Alex — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Our infra contact is eng-infra@crossroadshealth.com (I copied them above). For VPN/testing we'd prefer Dec 8–10 rather than the week of Dec 7 if that’s possible.
- On acceptance: can you confirm whether the acceptance tests will require any PHI in the payloads or whether you have a synthetic dataset we can use? Our security team will not allow real PHI for the pilot connectivity tests.
- Who on your side is the primary SME for model perf (for the baseline runs)? That person will need access to our staging endpoints for perf tuning.

If you can answer the above, we’ll block Dec 8–10 tentatively and loop in security for a quick review.

Thanks,
Julia
Head of Clinical Informatics
Crossroads Health
julia@crossroadshealth.com

Priya / Lauren / Ben —

Looping you in to transition this deal from AE to CS/Implementation. Thread above includes the Crossroads responses — highlights and asks below. I want this to be a light, deterministic handoff so we can hit the tentative Dec 8 kickoff.

Deal context (summary):
- Account: Crossroads Health (mid-market, regional EHR operator).
- Contract: Production hosted inference for EHR summarization (pilot scope spelled out in SOW).
- SLA: pilot target latency SLO and uptime targets are noted in the MAP; we can escalate to dedicated if pilot shows high qps.

Customer asks (from last message):
1) Preferred sprint-0 window: Dec 8–10 (they prefer this).
2) No PHI for initial connectivity/perf runs — they require synthetic payloads.
3) Infra contact: eng-infra@crossroadshealth.com (please include in all infra requests).

Suggested owner matrix (please confirm or reassign):
- Implementation Lead (sprint-0 & kick): Priya Natarajan (primary) — owner for runbook, test payloads, perf baseline.
- CS Manager / escalation: Lauren Bishop (secondary) — owns success criteria and acceptance communication.
- Tech contact / perf SME: Ben Carter — will run baseline model perf and advise on model/quantization choices.
- AE (me): Alex Martinez — will shepherd exec communications and unblock procurement if needed.

Attachments: CR_CSP_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (I left notes on the dates tab), crossroads_network_requirements.pdf

Immediate asks:
- Priya: confirm you can take primary and whether Dec 8–10 works for your team. Also confirm you have access to the HubSpot deal linked below to update the kickoff date.
- Ben: can you prepare a short perf-run checklist (VM specs, tokenization notes, sample synthetic inputs) by EOD Wed so we can share with Crossroads.
- Lauren: please draft a 1-paragraph kickoff email to the executive sponsor that we can send following infra sign-off.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/489-CR

Alex

Thanks Alex — I’ll take primary. Dec 8–10 works for the implementation team; I’ll send an internal kickoff checklist by tomorrow morning and request the following from Crossroads infra:

- Staging endpoint and a sandbox account (no PHI)
- Contact for port/VPC allowlisting (I’ll use eng-infra@crossroadshealth.com)
- Expected sample QPS for the baseline run

Ben: I’ll add you to the perf ticket — please drop the perf checklist in the ticket by EOD Wed as requested. Lauren: happy to have you draft the sponsor note and I’ll pull a short technical summary to append.

I’ll create the kickoff calendar event once Matthew confirms the preferred time on Dec 8; tentative invite: Dec 8, 10:00–11:00 PT.
